profile_text.body:
Chegg is a publicly traded American education technology company (ticker: CHGG, CIK 0001364954) that describes itself as providing homework help and study support across more than 50 subjects. Its site presents a platform offering 24/7 academic assistance, step-by-step problem solutions, and access to human experts, available through subscription tiers called Chegg Study and Chegg Study Pack. The company has operated since at least 2003 and frames its service around helping students work through difficult course material, with solutions described as informed by student feedback.

Chegg's AI product tracked on this site is CheggMate, categorized as an Education and Research AI tool and described as a study-focused AI assistant providing academic help. The product raises noted considerations around student data handling, content accuracy, honor code implications, and academic integrity. No litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC enforcement actions, or patent filings beyond the company's basic public-company profile are present in the available data.
